assumptions.statement: The site and key-area polygons are provisional rough constraints inferred from public text and approximate areas.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive design layers, figures, PDFs, metrics, and scenarios need full recalculation after cleared official geometry arrives.
assumptions.required_next_action: Obtain, register, verify, and replace cleared official boundary and key-area files.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, setbacks, parcels, ownership, existing-building condition, heritage controls, and municipal capacities are not supplied as cleared project data.
assumptions.impact: Building options and renewal actions are conceptual only and cannot determine statutory controls, demolition, construction, or engineering.
assumptions.required_next_action: Undertake official-control review, field survey, ownership check, and qualified multidisciplinary assessment.

assumptions.statement: Walking lines are conceptual relationships, not road alignments or operational forecasts.
assumptions.impact: No route, parking, bridge, tunnel, safety, or accessibility performance claim is made.
assumptions.required_next_action: Validate with transport, accessibility, safety, operations, and public participation processes.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios require purpose limitation, minimum data, human review, appeal, logging, and stop conditions before any trial.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards do not authorize surveillance, personal profiling, automated decision-making, or production deployment.
assumptions.required_next_action: Define data protection, procurement, safety, accountability, and community governance protocols.
